newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian palm oil prices stable, but olein soft.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian palm oil prices stable, but olein soft.

text.p: Indonesian crude palm oil prices were stable while olein prices softened on offshore influence in late trading on Thursday, traders said.
One trader in Medan said crude palm oil (CPO) was tendered at a higher level late in the afternoon on Thursday at 1,243 rupiah/kg, compared with 1,240 rupiah/kg on Wednesday.
He said short-covering might have forced buyers to enter the market.
However, olein prices remained soft due to sustained weak market sentiment offshore, traders said.
Another trader said plans by Indonesian commodity regulator Bulog to buy an additional 30,000 tonnes of CPO from state plantations had no immediate impact on the market.
"In the middle-term there may be some effect," he said.
Olein was quoted at 1,440 rupiah/kg in Medan, 1,460-70 rupiah/kg in Jakarta and 1,470-80 rupiah/kg in Surabaya.
